verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs show that items (tasks) exist and can be created, via the `create_item` event subscription and item views. Items can also be assigned, though the documented example is assigning items to agents treated 'like teammates'. Community users describe updating tickets in the tool day to day. missing for 10: explicit documentation of assigning items to human teammates, any evidence of due-date fields or deadlines on items, in-depth first-party task-management docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the assign-with-due-date workflow.
